what_went_wrong: First Jev probe run failed all 4 probes with F-AUTH/HTTP 403. Raw response bodies were Cloudflare error 1010 (Browser Integrity Check) rejecting urllib's default User-Agent 'Python-urllib/3.12' — not an authentication failure. The frozen task029 HttpTransport does not set a User-Agent header.
root_cause: Cloudflare BIC block on default Python UA; adapter transport lacks custom UA. Initially misdiagnosed as key rejection (F-AUTH, non-retryable).
what_i_did_wrong: Treated 403 as F-AUTH without inspecting the response body first; the body (error 1010) would have immediately identified Cloudflare vs real auth.
fix: Wrapped frozen HttpTransport in UATransport inside scripts/task026_jev_decision.py injecting user-agent 'task026-jev-decision/1.0' (frozen adapter module not modified). Re-run: all 4 probes 200 OK.
outcome_after_fix: 3/3 APPROVE majority, position-prior broken (A/C/B), negative control noul=0.03 pass.
